A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''clone''' of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] was a [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|Clone naval officer]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was one of [[Unidentified clone navigation officer 2 (Saleucami)|two]] officers on board [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|Arquitens-class light cruiser]] during the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|First Battle of Saleucami]]. He [[Death/Legends|died]] when the ship was destroyed by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].
